usage: agentware graph resume [-h] [--format {text,json}]
                              [--concurrency CONCURRENCY]
                              [--node-timeout NODE_TIMEOUT]
                              [--deadline DEADLINE] [--retry] [--now NOW]
                              name

positional arguments:
  name                  graph name

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --format {text,json}  output format (default: text)
  --concurrency CONCURRENCY
                        override the manifest concurrency
  --node-timeout NODE_TIMEOUT
                        per-node wall-clock watchdog hours
  --deadline DEADLINE   whole-run deadline hours
  --retry               re-offer a FAILED node exactly once (R-FAIL-04)
  --now NOW             inject the clock (ISO) for byte-identical replay
